prank_description: Rigged the pressure valves to sound a low flatulent tone under high flow, entirely relying on Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea.
summary: Hector rewired the ferrofluid pipes for Silas, but Silas missed it, leaving Ryn to deal with the prank.

narrative_prose: The acrid scent of ozone and heated copper filled the cramped, stifling interior of the primary pump room. Hector wiped sweat from his brow, focusing intently as he CONSUMED the lingering heat radiating from the ferrofluid lines. He carefully shifted his grip to DEFEND his fragile calibration array from the immense pressure building within the pipes. The underlying Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea threatened to buck the entire manifold out of alignment. He needed to ATTRACT Silas's attention without being too obvious, relying on the subtle resonance of the rigged valves to do the trick. A low, mocking hum vibrated through the floor plates. Satisfied, Hector spun around and tossed the heavy brass calibration baton directly into Kaio's waiting hands, flashing a reckless grin.
